classes.name: IGESGraph_LineFontDefPattern
classes.summary:
defines IGESLineFontDefPattern, Type <304> Form <2> in package {@link IGESGraph | `IGESGraph`}
Line Font may be defined by repetition of a basic pattern of visible-blank(or, on-off) segments superimposed on a line or a curve. The line or curve is then displayed according to the basic pattern.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class LineFontDefPattern.
- allSegLength : Containing lengths of respective segments
- aPattern : HAsciiString indicating visible-blank segments

instanceMethods.name: NbSegments
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of segments in the visible-blank pattern

instanceMethods.name: Length
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Length of Index'th segment of the basic pattern raises exception if Index <= 0 or Index > NbSegments

instanceMethods.name: DisplayPattern
instanceMethods.comment: returns the string indicating which segments of the basic pattern are visible and which are blanked. e.g: theNbSegments = 5 and if Bit Pattern = 10110, which means that segments 2, 3 and 5 are visible, whereas segments 1 and 4 are blank. The method returns "2H16" as the HAsciiString. Note: The bits are right justified. (16h = 10110)

instanceMethods.name: IsVisible
instanceMethods.comment: The Display Pattern is decrypted to return True if the Index'th basic pattern is Visible, False otherwise. If Index > NbSegments or Index <= 0 then return value is False.

classes.name: IGESGraph_LineFontDefTemplate
classes.summary:
defines IGESLineFontDefTemplate, Type <304> Form <1> in package {@link IGESGraph | `IGESGraph`}
Line Font can be defined as a repetition of Template figure that is displayed at regularly spaced locations along a planer anchoring curve. The anchoring curve itself has no visual purpose.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (anOrientation: number, aTemplate: IGESBasic_SubfigureDef, aDistance: number, aScale: number): void
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class LineFontDefTemplate.
- anOrientation : Orientation of Template figure on anchoring curve
- aTemplate : SubfigureDef entity used as Template figure
- aDistance : Distance between the neighbouring Template figures
- aScale : Scale factor applied to the Template figure

instanceMethods.name: Orientation
instanceMethods.comment: if return value = 0, Each Template display is oriented by aligning the axis of the SubfigureDef with the axis of the definition space of the anchoring curve. = 1, Each Template display is oriented by aligning X-axis of the SubfigureDef with the tangent vector of the anchoring curve at the point of incidence of the curve and the origin of subfigure. Similarly Z-axis is aligned.

instanceMethods.name: TemplateEntity
instanceMethods.comment: returns SubfigureDef as the Entity used as Template figure.

instanceMethods.name: Distance
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Distance between any two Template figures on the anchoring curve.

instanceMethods.name: Scale
instanceMethods.comment: returns the Scaling factor applied to SubfigureDef to form Template figure.

classes.name: IGESGraph_TextFontDef
classes.summary:
defines IGES Text Font Definition Entity, Type <310> in package {@link IGESGraph | `IGESGraph`}
Used to define the appearance of characters in a text font. It may be used to describe a complete font or a modification to a subset of characters in another font.

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (aFontCode: number, aFontName: TCollection_HAsciiString, aSupersededFont: number, aSupersededEntity: IGESGraph_TextFontDef, aScale: number, allASCIICodes: NCollection_HArray1_int, allNextCharX: NCollection_HArray1_int, allNextCharY: NCollection_HArray1_int, allPenMotions: NCollection_HArray1_int, allPenFlags: IGESBasic_HArray1OfHArray1OfInteger, allMovePenToX: IGESBasic_HArray1OfHArray1OfInteger, allMovePenToY: IGESBasic_HArray1OfHArray1OfInteger): void
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class TextFontDef.
- aFontCode : Font Code
- aFontName : Font Name
- aSupersededFont : Number of superseded font
- aSupersededEntity : Text Definition Entity
- aScale : No. of grid units = 1 text height unit
- allASCIICodes : ASCII codes for characters
- allNextCharX & Y : Grid locations of the next character's origin (Integer vals)
- allPenMotions : No. of pen motions for the characters
- allPenFlags : Pen up/down flags, 0 = Down (default), 1 = Up
- allMovePenToX & Y : Grid locations the pen will move to This method initializes the fields of the class TextFontDef. An exception is raised if the lengths of allASCIICodes, allNextChars, allPenMotions, allPenFlags and allMovePenTo are not same.

instanceMethods.name: FontCode
instanceMethods.comment: returns the font code.

instanceMethods.name: FontName
instanceMethods.comment: returns the font name.

instanceMethods.name: IsSupersededFontEntity
instanceMethods.comment: True if this definition supersedes another TextFontDefinition Entity, False if it supersedes value.

instanceMethods.name: SupersededFontCode
instanceMethods.comment: returns the font number which this entity modifies.

instanceMethods.name: SupersededFontEntity
instanceMethods.comment: returns the font entity which this entity modifies.

instanceMethods.name: Scale
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of grid units which equal one text height unit.

instanceMethods.name: NbCharacters
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of characters in this definition.

instanceMethods.name: ASCIICode
instanceMethods.comment: returns the ASCII code of Chnum'th character. Exception OutOfRange is raised if Chnum <= 0 or Chnum > NbCharacters

instanceMethods.name: NextCharOrigin
instanceMethods.signature: (Chnum: number, NX: number, NY: number): { NX: number; NY: number }
instanceMethods.comment:
returns grid location of origin of character next to Chnum'th char. Exception OutOfRange is raised if Chnum <= 0 or Chnum > NbCharacters
@returns A result object with fields:
- `NX`: updated value from the call.
- `NY`: updated value from the call.

instanceMethods.name: NbPenMotions
instanceMethods.comment: returns number of pen motions for Chnum'th character. Exception OutOfRange is raised if Chnum <= 0 or Chnum > NbCharacters

instanceMethods.name: IsPenUp
instanceMethods.comment: returns pen status(True if 1, False if 0) of Motionnum'th motion of Chnum'th character. Exception raised if Chnum <= 0 or Chnum > NbCharacters or Motionnum <= 0 or Motionnum > NbPenMotions

instanceMethods.name: NextPenPosition

classes.summary:
defines IGESUniformRectGrid, Type <406> Form <22> in package {@link IGESGraph | `IGESGraph`}
Stores sufficient information for the creation of a uniform rectangular grid within a drawing

instanceMethods.name: Init
instanceMethods.signature: (nbProps: number, finite: number, line: number, weighted: number, aGridPoint: gp_XY, aGridSpacing: gp_XY, pointsX: number, pointsY: number): void
instanceMethods.comment:
This method is used to set the fields of the class UniformRectGrid.
- nbProps : Number of property values (NP = 9)
- finite : Finite/Infinite grid flag
- line : Line/Point grid flag
- weighted : Weighted/Unweighted grid flag
- aGridPoint : Point on the grid
- aGridSpacing : Grid spacing
- pointsX : No. of points/lines in X Direction
- pointsY : No. of points/lines in Y Direction

instanceMethods.name: NbPropertyValues
instanceMethods.comment: returns the number of property values in <me>.

instanceMethods.name: IsFinite
instanceMethods.comment: returns False if <me> is an infinite grid, True if <me> is a finite grid.

instanceMethods.name: IsLine
instanceMethods.comment: returns False if <me> is a Point grid, True if <me> is a Line grid.

instanceMethods.name: IsWeighted
instanceMethods.comment: returns False if <me> is a Weighted grid, True if <me> is not a Weighted grid.

instanceMethods.name: GridPoint
instanceMethods.comment: returns coordinates of lower left corner, if <me> is a finite grid, coordinates of an arbitrary point, if <me> is an infinite grid.

instanceMethods.name: GridSpacing
instanceMethods.comment: returns the grid-spacing in drawing coordinates.

instanceMethods.name: NbPointsX
instanceMethods.comment: returns the no. of points/lines in X direction (only applicable if `IsFinite()` = 1, i.e: a finite grid).

instanceMethods.name: NbPointsY
instanceMethods.comment: returns the no. of points/lines in Y direction (only applicable if `IsFinite()` = 1, i.e: a finite grid).
